newsitem.title: SOUTH AFRICA: Persetel Holdings details acquisitions.
newsitem.headline: Persetel Holdings details acquisitions.

text.p: Persetel Holdings Ltd announced on Monday it had bought data security technology supplier Nanoteq, security systems Consultancy in Advanced Technology and 51 percent of Mosaic Software.

It said the amount involved was 71.5 million rand which would be settled by the issue of new Persetel shares. The shares would be issued without the right to receive the final dividend declared in respect of Persetel's financial year ended May 31 1996 and would be listed on the Johannesburg Stock Exchange.
